title: 第7章 野区的战斗第8章 优美如画的操作
content_zh:
第七章 野区的战斗
一击未中，盲僧心中，暗自叫遭。
要是‘天音波’能够命中的话，虽说红BUFF被抢，但是自己身上还是有着从蓝色方野区拿来的红，根本不会虚。
可是现在‘天音波’竟然被躲了过去，还是在那么近距离的情况下。
不由得盲僧有些羞愧，随后他便想到潘森所说的，这个瑞雯好像并不是这个段位的。
本来有些不屑的盲僧，在见识到对方的走位和意识之后，现在完全赞同潘森的想法，这瑞雯估计不是黄铜白银分段的。
可是就算他在心中赞叹道，苏环也不会手下留情。
一记普攻击出，有着红BUFF在手，瞬间触发了其灼伤减速效果，一瞬间苏环便黏上了盲僧。
期间盲僧一击‘天雷破’打掉了瑞雯一小截血量，随后瞬间触发二段‘摧筋断骨’的减速效果。
看着自己还有半血，盲僧觉得自己还是可以跑掉的。
然而苏环却让事实告诉了他，还是太异想天开了。
普攻击出的瞬间，便瞬间接上了第二段‘折翼之舞’，随后又是一记普攻，之后触发第三段‘折翼之舞’的效果，狠狠向着盲僧的身体劈落而下，击飞盲僧，再接一记普攻。
整个动作，没有一丝生涩，非常流畅自然，给人一种连贯异常的享受。
看得身后的王清雅异彩涟涟，虽然苏环的光速QA非常迅速，整个过程不到两秒，但是还是被注意力非常集中的王清雅看出了一点异样。
折翼之舞里，好像还夹带着普攻，王清雅猜测道，但是有些不敢确定。
毕竟苏环操作的太快了，不到两秒的时间，也就是一点几秒。
一点几秒能做什么，估计也就是三段‘折翼之舞’的时间吧。
王清雅实在有些疑惑。
屏幕里已经彻底被红BUFF黏上的盲僧，再加上其持续掉血效果，本来只剩半血的盲僧，一下子就残血了，只剩两格的血量。
看着哗啦啦直掉的血量，盲僧有些目瞪口呆，什么时候瑞雯的三段‘折翼之舞’有着如此的高伤害了，而且还是在对方是带着多兰盾的情况下。

要是对方多兰剑出门，自己现在不是已经被秒了？
毫不犹豫的盲僧按下了闪现。
苏环见白光一闪，却是对方盲僧用了闪现，就要闪现跟进。
但是他的手指却硬生生的停住了。
白光一闪，对方盲僧并没有闪到墙的另一边，而是戏剧性的撞墙了。
苏环一看，淡淡一笑，估计对面盲僧有些紧张了。
闪现撞墙的盲僧，一瞬间绝望了。
“盲僧，快往上路跑，用金钟罩到我身边来。”
就在这时，上路潘森竟然跑来支援了。
原来当潘森复活后，到达高地的时候。就看见瑞雯在自家野区和盲僧打了起来，随后他想也不想直接就往野区支援了过来。
不过当盲僧听到潘森的话后，却是苦笑，自己的W技能‘铁布衫’已经在刚刚位了抵挡瑞雯的伤害已经使用过了，就算有着蓝BUFF的减CD效果，现在还有几秒冷却呢。
“潘森，不用来了，你去线上吧。”
知道自己必死的盲僧，对着潘森说道。
“豹女一起来野区，包抄瑞雯。”但是潘森仿佛没有听到一般，对着中路的豹女说道。
本来见到自家盲僧在野区被抓，心里想要去支援的豹女，却是因为距离太远，而打消了念头。
前去支援的话，估计还没入野区，盲僧的人头就要被拿下了，所以豹女虽然心里焦急，但是有心无力，并没有前去支援。
只不过看见潘森往野区支援过去，豹女眼睛一亮，随后便听到潘森的话。
“好的，你牵制住瑞雯就行，等我过来。”
看着潘森还是一级的状态，豹女有些担心的吩咐道。
“好的。”

就在两人交谈之际，苏环已经收下了盲僧的人头。
‘一步一人头’击杀了‘光脚不穿鞋’
虽然击杀了盲僧，但是苏环瑞雯的血量已经是只有三分之一了，而且唯一的血瓶也在和盲僧对拼的时候用掉。
看着血瓶的状态，估计还能补充个几十点血量。
随后苏环便看见从上路二塔下边的草里，冲出了一位潘森。
潘森一看见苏环，便要一标长毛投掷过来，但是苏环早有预料。
一个小幅度位移，直接进入了草丛。
失去视野的潘森，手中的长矛怎么也放不出去。
看见瑞雯进入草丛，潘森二话不说直接跟进。
显然潘森已经忘记自己还有一个守卫图腾没有放。
但是已经急眼的潘森哪还顾得了这些，有大好机会可以杀掉瑞雯，报仇血恨，已经红眼了。
一入草丛，潘森就发现一位手持断剑的女战士。
“瑞雯没走？”心中喜悦刚掠过。
就见瑞雯大剑一挥，砍在身上。
配合红BUFF的灼伤效果，一瞬间打掉了潘森五分之一的血量。
“这伤害，太**了吧。”看见瑞雯的伤害，潘森好似被一股凉水浇下，瞬间清醒了过了，就要往后退去。
但是在苏环心中却是理所当然，自己已经接近四级了，而对面的潘森才一级，等级压制下，再配合着红BUFF，虽然血量不多了，但是却可以完全反打击杀。
“潘森拖住，我快要到了。”
就在潘森被瑞雯伤害吓住的同时，耳边却响起了豹女的声音。
看着面前吃了自己一记长矛投掷后，半血不到的瑞雯，潘森牙齿一咬。

“就算死，也要把你换掉。”
随后点燃套上，再一记普攻，又打掉瑞雯一点血量。
看着并没有退去，而是和自己对拼的潘森，苏环心神一动，见到小地图豹女已经消失有一段时间了。
知道豹女估计已经到了，而且很可能就在红BUFF下方草丛阴人。
仿佛察觉到什么的苏环，一瞬间放弃了攻击，而是微微往后退了两步。
随后他便看到一标豹女的标枪投掷，险而又险离他极近的擦肩而过。
“这他妈的都能躲过去？”豹女一见对方瑞雯躲过了自己一发标枪投掷，有些目瞪口呆，非常怀疑草里是不是放了眼。
在瑞雯面前的潘森也是有些欲哭无泪，自己都那么努力演了，还是被瑞雯躲过了豹女的标枪投掷。
而站立后方的王清雅看见苏环操控瑞雯往后退去的时候，本来还有些疑惑。
只不过当她看见豹女的标枪投掷隔着墙穿刺而来被躲过去后，心中顿时有种膜拜的冲动。
她能确定，下方草丛是没有眼位的，瑞雯应该是看不见豹女的。
他是怎么知道豹女在那的？一瞬间王清雅疑惑顿生。

Chapter 7 Battle in the Wild Area
One blow missed, and the blind monk secretly cried out in his heart.
If the 'Tian Yin Wave' can hit, even though the red BUFF is robbed, he still has the red from the blue jungle area, and he will not be weak at all.
But now the 'Tian Yin Wave' was actually dodged, and it was still at such a close distance.
The blind monk couldn't help but feel a little ashamed, and then he thought of what Pan Sen said, this Riven didn't seem to be of this rank.
The blind monk, who was originally a little disdainful, now fully agrees with Pan Sen's idea after seeing the opponent's movement and consciousness. This Raven is probably not made of brass or silver.
But even if he praised in his heart, Su Huan would not show mercy.
A basic attack was launched, with a red BUFF in hand, which instantly triggered its burning and slowing effect. In an instant, Su Huan was stuck to the blind monk.
During this period, the blind monk knocked out a small amount of Ruiwen's health with a strike of 'Heavenly Thunder Breaker', and then instantly triggered the second phase of the 'bone-breaking' deceleration effect.
Seeing that he still had half health, the blind monk felt that he could still run away.
However, Su Huan let the facts tell him, it was still too whimsical.
The moment the basic attack was launched, the second 'Dance of Broken Wings' was instantly followed, followed by another basic attack, and then the effect of the third 'Dance of Broken Wings' was triggered, slamming down towards the blind monk's body, knocking the blind monk away, and then followed up with another basic attack.
There is no jerkiness in the whole movement, it is very smooth and natural, giving people a coherent and unusual enjoyment.
Wang Qingya behind him could see the colorful scene. Although Su Huan's light speed QA was very fast and the whole process took less than two seconds, Wang Qingya, who was very focused, still noticed something strange.
The Dance of Broken Wings seemed to include a basic attack, Wang Qingya guessed, but was not sure.
After all, Su Huan operated too fast, in less than two seconds, which was only a few seconds.
What can be done in one o'clock and a few seconds, it is probably the time of three "Dance of Broken Wings".
Wang Qingya was really confused.
The blind monk on the screen had been completely covered in red BUFF, and coupled with its continuous blood loss effect, the blind monk who originally only had half health left, suddenly lost all health, with only two bars of health left.
Seeing the plummeting blood volume, the blind monk was a little stunned. When did Riven's three stages of 'Dance of Broken Wings' have such high damage, and this was even when the opponent was wearing a Dolan Shield.
If the opponent Dolan Jian goes out, wouldn't he be killed by now?
Blind Sin pressed Flash without hesitation.
Su Huan saw a flash of white light, but it was the other blind monk who used Flash and was about to follow up with Flash.
But his fingers stopped abruptly.
With a flash of white light, the opponent's blind monk did not dodge to the other side of the wall, but crashed into the wall dramatically.
Su Huan looked at it and smiled faintly, guessing that the blind monk opposite him was a little nervous.
The blind monk flashed into the wall and became desperate for a moment.
"Blind monk, run up the road quickly and use the golden bell to come to me."
At this moment, Pan Sen came to support him on the road.
It turned out that after Pan Sen was resurrected, he arrived at the high ground. He saw Riven fighting with the blind monk in his own jungle area, and then he went directly to the jungle area to support without thinking.
However, when the blind monk heard Pan Sen's words, he smiled bitterly. His W skill "Iron Shirt" had been used just now to resist Riven's damage. Even with the CD reduction effect of the blue BUFF, it still has a few seconds to cool down.
"Pan Sen, there's no need to come. You can go online."
The blind monk, knowing that he was bound to die, said to Pan Sen.
"Leopard Girl, come to the jungle together and outflank Ruiwen." But Pan Sen didn't seem to hear him and said to Leopard Girl in the middle.
Leopard Girl originally wanted to go to support her blind monk when she saw him being captured in the wild, but she gave up the idea because the distance was too far.
If you go to support, you probably haven’t entered the jungle yet.The monk's head was about to be taken off, so although Leopard Girl was anxious, she was helpless and did not go to support him.
But when she saw Pan Sen going to the wild area to support him, Leopard Girl's eyes lit up, and then she heard Pan Sen's words.
"Okay, just hold Ruiwen down and wait for me to come over."
Seeing that Pan Sen was still in the first level state, Leopard Girl ordered with some worry.
"Okay."
While the two were talking, Su Huan had already accepted the blind monk's head.
‘One step at a time’ kills ‘barefoot without shoes’
Although he killed the blind monk, Su Huanruiwen's blood volume was only one-third, and the only blood bottle was also used up when fighting against the blind monk.
Looking at the state of the blood bottle, it is estimated that it can replenish dozens of points of blood.
Then Su Huan saw a Pan Sen rushing out of the grass under the second tower on the upper road.
As soon as Pan Sen saw Su Huan, he wanted to throw a long hair at him, but Su Huan had expected it.
A small displacement, directly into the grass.
Pan Sen, who had lost his vision, couldn't release the spear in his hand.
Seeing Ruiwen enter the grass, Pan Sen followed her without saying a word.
Apparently Pan Sen had forgotten that he still had a guard totem left.
But Pan Sen, who was already impatient, could not care about this. He had a great opportunity to kill Ruiwen and avenge the blood feud. He was already red-eyed.
As soon as he entered the grass, Pan Sen found a female warrior holding a broken sword.
"Ruiwen didn't leave?" Joy just passed through her heart.
Then he saw Ruiwen swing her sword and slash her body.
Coupled with the burning effect of the red BUFF, one-fifth of Panson's health was wiped out in an instant.
"This injury is too cruel." Seeing Ruiwen's injury, Pan Sen seemed to be doused with cold water. He suddenly woke up and was about to step back.
But in Su Huan's mind, it was a matter of course. He was already close to level four, while Pan Sen on the opposite side was only level one. Under the level suppression, coupled with the red BUFF, although his health was low, he could completely counterattack and kill.
"Pan Sen, hold on, I'm almost there."
Just when Pan Sen was frightened by Raven's injury, Leopard Girl's voice sounded in his ears.
Panson gritted his teeth as he looked at Riven, who was half-healthy after taking a spear throw from him.
"Even if I die, I will replace you."
Then he ignited it and put it on, and made another basic attack, knocking out another bit of Riven's health.
Looking at Pan Sen who did not retreat but was fighting with him, Su Huan was moved and saw that the little leopard girl on the map had disappeared for a while.
I know that the leopard girl has probably arrived, and there is probably a shadowy figure in the grass under the red buff.
Su Huan, who seemed to have noticed something, gave up the attack for a moment and took two steps back slightly.
Then he saw a javelin thrown by a leopard girl, narrowly missing him at an extremely close distance.
"Can you fucking dodge this?" When Leopard Girl saw that Ruiwen had dodged one of her javelin throws, she was a little dumbfounded and wondered if Cao Li had let it go.
In front of Raven, Pan Sen was on the verge of tears. He tried so hard to act, but Raven still dodged Leopard Girl's javelin throw.
Wang Qingya, who was standing behind, was a little confused when she saw Su Huan controlling Ruiwen to retreat.
But when she saw Leopard Girl's javelin piercing through the wall and being dodged, she felt an urge to worship in her heart.
She was sure that there were no eye positions in the grass below, and Raven should not be able to see the Leopard Girl.
How did he know Leopard Girl was there? For a moment, Wang Qingya was confused.
